verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs include an API reference section, with pages for 'Custom Integration Push APIs' (Integration Monitoring) and 'Framework Health & Vendor Data APIs', plus inbound webhook endpoints that push data into Sprinto. So a documented public API exists, but the evidence shows only page titles and suggests a narrow scope focused on data push and read-out rather than full programmatic control. The OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of endpoint breadth covering core actions (controls, policies, tasks, evidence, audits), authentication and rate-limit docs, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
